message: The boundary grants iam:Get* and iam:List* on Resource: *, which includes sensitive IAM enumeration APIs (GetCredentialReport, GetAccountAuthorizationDetails, ListAccessKeys, ListMFADevices) beyond typical operational read access. Replace wildcards with specific required actions.
The permission boundary contains only Allow statements with no explicit Deny for dangerous write operations. An explicit Deny provides defense-in-depth if the boundary is extended.

Boundary Allow statement 'unnamed' grants cross-account-capable actions (s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket) without aws:ResourceAccount condition. The created role could access resources in other accounts if cross-account resource policies permit it. Add "StringEquals": {"aws:ResourceAccount": "${aws:PrincipalAccount}"} to restrict to same-account.

Boundary ARN domain mismatch: template references domain 'partner12.com' but metadata declares partner_domain 'app.partner-12.io'. This may enforce another partner's boundary. Expected: 'arn:aws:iam::partner:policy/permissions-boundary/app.partner-12.io/Partner12Boundary_2026_04_20'.

Boundary name mismatch: template references 'partner12_reader_boundary_2026_04_20' but metadata declares boundary_name 'Partner12Boundary_2026_04_20'.
